title: Media and image generation
lede: I wanted any agent in my estate to be able to make images, video and narration on my own GPUs, without anyone hand-starting a ComfyUI server or copying files between machines. The hard parts are around the rendering: a GPU is shared with other work, model files are large, a render can finish while its delivery fails, and an agent that retries blindly burns GPU time on work it already did. So these 33 tools treat every step as a durable operation with its own identifier. Starting a service goes through the compute budget. Model downloads are planned before they run and checked after.
evidence: GPU media generation for AI agents: 33 tools let an agent start a managed ComfyUI service on a chosen GPU, plan model downloads, render images and video and produce narration.
Durable operations design: every step has its own identifier, starts go through the compute budget, and a render is tracked apart from its delivery so a failed copy never re-renders.
author: Corey James
